description: Get All. Part of the Ewb APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 10. Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: asc. Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.

gstin.description: Gstin query parameter. Default: gstin. Optional.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: billingDate. Optional.

failedRequestLog.description: Failed request log query parameter. Optional.
